reason: Audited the current definition against the sources and re-derived the conventions. Closed-disc counts use local multiplicity with poles as the a=infinity divisor; the integrated count regularises the centre by n(0,a)log r exactly as Eremenko footnote 1 (p.1) and Goldberg-Ostrovskii Ch.1 Sec.2 require. The chordal normalisation is diameter one: stereographic projection gives |sigma(w)-sigma(a)|=2|w-a|/sqrt((1+|w|^2)(1+|a|^2)), so delta is half the Euclidean chord and delta(w,infinity)=1/sqrt(1+|w|^2), matching Eremenko p.5 and Goldberg-Ostrovskii pp.17-18; both sphere endpoints and delta(infinity,infinity)=0 are declared. The definition asserts no unproved property; finiteness and continuity are proved in the level-1 well-definedness theorem, and the attained target of a constant map is explicitly excluded from n and m. No AC is used or needed.
